name: hcup_nis
description: AHRQ HCUP National Inpatient Sample (NIS 2020, ICD-10-CM/PCS). Three cohort queries reproduced from George et al. (cervical cancer + radical hysterectomy), Chung et al. (oropharyngeal/tongue cancer + transoral surgery), and Habermann et al. (breast cancer + mastectomy). ICD-9 codes from the original publications were translated to ICD-10-CM/PCS via HCUP GEM.

columns.name: dx_cervical_ca
columns.note: Invasive cervical cancer (ICD-9 180.x). George et al.

columns.name: dx_tongue
columns.note: Tongue cancer (base + other parts). Chung et al.

columns.name: dx_breast_ca
columns.note: Invasive (C50) or in-situ (D05) breast cancer (ICD-9 174.x, 233.0). Habermann et al.

columns.name: pr_mastectomy
columns.note: Unilateral or bilateral mastectomy (ICD-9 85.33-.48). Habermann et al.
